title: Homebuyer closing checklist
use_when: Use when a homebuyer with an approved mortgage is getting ready for the closing table; use the program needs list (for example mortgage-fha or mortgage-conventional-salaried) for the documents the lender underwrites with.
note: Items follow the CFPB mortgage closing checklist PDF and the CFPB Buying a House closing pages, Closing Disclosure explainer, Ask CFPB answer 1907 and closing-scam blog post. It covers what the buyer gathers, reviews and brings; it does not cover state closing practices, the seller's documents, or refinance-only items such as the right to cancel.

situations.large-deposit: Have you recently made one or more large deposits into your bank account?
situations.other-income: Do you rely on regular income from a non-employment source such as child support, alimony or rental income?
situations.flood-risk: Is flooding a risk for the home you are buying?
situations.condo: Are you buying a condo or co-op unit?
situations.co-borrower: Is someone borrowing with you or co-signing the loan?

items.label: Any additional documents your lender asks for
items.detail: Send copies and keep your originals; include every page of multi-page documents, even pages marked intentionally left blank. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Documents showing where each recent large deposit came from
items.detail: Requirements vary by lender; ask which documents they need. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Proof that the non-employment income will continue at the same level
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Written homeowner's insurance quotes
items.detail: Share the quotes you are considering with your loan officer and ask whether they meet the lender's requirements.

items.label: Final information on the homeowner's insurance policy you chose
items.detail: Send it to your loan officer.

items.label: Separate flood insurance policy
items.detail: Homeowner's insurance typically does not cover flood damage.

items.label: Your own insurance policy for the unit
items.detail: The association's master insurance usually covers only the common areas.

items.label: Your Closing Disclosure
items.detail: By law you must receive it three business days before closing. Ask your lender or closing agent at least a week ahead how it will be sent. Bring it to closing to compare with the final documents.

items.label: Your most recent Loan Estimate
items.detail: Compare loan terms, loan amount, monthly payment, closing costs and cash to close against the Closing Disclosure.

items.label: Advance copies of the promissory note, mortgage (security instrument or deed of trust) and deed
items.detail: Ask the lender or closing agent to send them at the same time as the Closing Disclosure.

items.label: Initial escrow disclosure
items.detail: Listed among the documents to review before closing.

items.label: Your purchase contract
items.detail: Know what it says before closing, including any seller credits or repairs agreed with the seller.

items.label: Name, phone number and role of the person conducting your closing, with the date, time and address
items.detail: Checklist step 1: title agent, escrow agent, closing attorney or other.

items.label: The amount you need to pay at closing and the form of payment required
items.detail: Checklist step 2: ask the person conducting the closing about how much you will pay and whether by cashier's check or wire transfer.

items.label: Names and primary phone numbers of two trusted people who can confirm payment instructions
items.detail: Checklist step 4: for example your real estate agent and settlement agent. Bring the list to closing.

items.label: Wire instructions confirmed by phone or in person with a trusted contact
items.detail: Verify the account name and number using the phone number you agreed on earlier; never follow instructions or links in an email. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Cashier's check or proof of wire transfer for the exact amount needed to close
items.detail: Checklist, At closing.

items.label: Your checkbook, in case of last-minute changes
items.detail: Checklist, At closing.

items.label: Driver's license or other ID
items.detail: Checklist, At closing. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Your co-borrower or co-signer, present at closing
items.detail: Checklist, At closing.

items.label: The complete closing packet, saved exactly as received
items.detail: Checklist, After closing: check it includes the Closing Disclosure, promissory note, mortgage (security instrument or deed of trust) and deed.
